parsed.rationale: Both `app:WatchXYC` (WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift:190) and `app:iOS` (WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Extensions.swift:27) declare an identical `extension SwiftUI.Image` with the same 2 shared fields and no differing slots (jaccard: null, differing_slots: null), indicating a true exact duplicate. Neither record carries any restraint marker (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), so consolidation is appropriate. The extension should be moved to a shared utilities target that both the WatchXYC and iOS app targets already depend on — if such a shared module exists (e.g., a common Extensions or Shared package), it should live there; otherwise the iOS NowPlayingWidget Extensions.swift is the more natural host given it already aggregates extensions, and the WatchXYC copy should be deleted. This eliminates the risk of the two copies diverging silently.
